non_engagement_letters_approved_check.name: non_engagement_letters_approved_check
non_engagement_letters_approved_check.value: "non_engagement_letters"."status" in ('awaiting_approval','cancelled') or "non_engagement_letters"."approved_by_user_id" is not null or "non_engagement_letters"."auto_approved"

party_retention_requests_decided_check.name: party_retention_requests_decided_check
party_retention_requests_decided_check.value: "party_retention_requests"."status" = 'open' or ("party_retention_requests"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "party_retention_requests"."legal_basis" is not null)

calendar_events_confirmed_by_check.name: calendar_events_confirmed_by_check
calendar_events_confirmed_by_check.value: "calendar_events"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("calendar_events"."confirmed_by_user_id" is not null and "calendar_events"."confirmed_at" is not null)

flags_open_dedupe_key.name: flags_open_dedupe_key
flags_open_dedupe_key.where: "flags"."resolved_at" is null and "flags"."dedupe_key" is not null

flags_resolution_reason_check.name: flags_resolution_reason_check
flags_resolution_reason_check.value: "flags"."resolved_at" is null or ("flags"."resolution_reason" is not null and length("flags"."resolution_reason") > 0)

notification_outbox_recipient_consistenc.name: notification_outbox_recipient_consistency_check
notification_outbox_recipient_consistenc.value:
("notification_outbox"."recipient_type" = 'user' and "notification_outbox"."recipient_user_id" is not null and "notification_outbox"."recipient_party_id" is null)
      or ("notification_outbox"."recipient_type" = 'party' and "notification_outbox"."recipient_party_id" is not null and "notification_outbox"."recipient_user_id" is null)

tasks_owner_consistency_check.name: tasks_owner_consistency_check
tasks_owner_consistency_check.value:
("tasks"."owner_type" = 'user' and "tasks"."owner_user_id" is not null and "tasks"."owner_party_id" is null)
      or ("tasks"."owner_type" = 'client' and "tasks"."owner_party_id" is not null and "tasks"."owner_user_id" is null)
      or ("tasks"."owner_type" = 'firm' and "tasks"."owner_user_id" is null and "tasks"."owner_party_id" is null)

intake_assignment_blocks_target_check.name: intake_assignment_blocks_target_check
intake_assignment_blocks_target_check.value: "intake_assignment_blocks"."matter_id" is not null or "intake_assignment_blocks"."party_id" is not null

intake_emergency_alerts_downgrade_reason.name: intake_emergency_alerts_downgrade_reason_check
intake_emergency_alerts_downgrade_reason.value: "intake_emergency_alerts"."downgraded_at" is null or ("intake_emergency_alerts"."downgrade_reason" is not null and length("intake_emergency_alerts"."downgrade_reason") > 0)

intake_fit_evaluations_decision_reason_c.name: intake_fit_evaluations_decision_reason_check
intake_fit_evaluations_decision_reason_c.value: "intake_fit_evaluations"."decision" is null or ("intake_fit_evaluations"."decision_reason" is not null and length("intake_fit_evaluations"."decision_reason") > 0)

intake_on_call_rota_shape_check.name: intake_on_call_rota_shape_check
intake_on_call_rota_shape_check.value:
("intake_on_call_rota"."starts_at" is not null and "intake_on_call_rota"."ends_at" is not null and "intake_on_call_rota"."weekday" is null)
      or ("intake_on_call_rota"."weekday" in ('mon','tue','wed','thu','fri','sat','sun') and "intake_on_call_rota"."start_time" is not null and "intake_on_call_rota"."end_time" is not null and "intake_on_call_rota"."starts_at" is null)

user_capabilities_revoke_reason_check.name: user_capabilities_revoke_reason_check
user_capabilities_revoke_reason_check.value: "user_capabilities"."revoked_at" is null or "user_capabilities"."revoke_reason" is not null
